# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Luma — Stale path denylist
#
# Patterns (POSIX extended regex, one per line) for source files,
# directories, and CMake modules that have been removed or renamed.
# The Docs Consistency workflow (.github/workflows/docs.yml) fails
# if any of these appear in the tracked documentation, prompt,
# CMake-module, and Dev Container files it scans (see its paths: list),
# catching references that outlived the thing they pointed at.
#
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored. Add a pattern
# here whenever you delete or rename a path that documentation might
# still mention.
#
# A scanned line that must legitimately mention a denied name — for
# example a learnings entry recording that something was removed —
# is exempted by carrying the literal marker "stale-path-ok" (in
# Markdown, as a trailing "<!-- stale-path-ok -->" comment). Use it
# sparingly: it hides the whole line from every pattern.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Non-root README.md files were renamed to DIRECTORY.md (2026-08).
# The root README.md still exists — this pattern catches only paths
# with a named directory prefix (e.g. "docs/README.md"), excluding
# relative parent refs like "../README.md" which point to the root.
[a-z][a-z0-9._-]*/README\.md

# GraphicalUi and Luma Solaris were removed (2026-09). These patterns catch
# any lingering documentation reference to the deleted modules, assets,
# prelude, generators, CMake module, and CSS lint infrastructure.
graphicalui[a-z0-9_]*\.(cpp|hpp)
gui_prelude
generate_gui_assets\.mjs
generate_prelude_asset\.mjs
external/gui-framework
LumaWebView\.cmake
stylelint\.config\.mjs

# Executables moved to the build-directory root on every generator (2026-11):
# build/luma(.exe), never a per-configuration subdirectory such as the old
# build/Release/ — in any build tree (build-debug/, build-msvc/, build-fuzz/, ...).
# Document the non-primary multi-config location generically as <build>/<Config>/.
build[-a-z0-9]*[/\\](Release|Debug|RelWithDebInfo|MinSizeRel)[/\\]

# The unused arm64-cross, release-no-tests, and macos-universal CMake presets
# were removed (2026-11). CHANGELOG.md is not scanned, so its history entry is
# unaffected; a scanned line that must name them as removed carries the
# stale-path-ok marker (see below).
(^|[^a-z0-9-])(arm64-cross|release-no-tests|macos-universal)([^a-z0-9-]|$)

# The PowerShell + bash prompt-pipeline runners and the Pester harness were
# replaced by scripts/pipeline/luma_pipeline.py (2026-11).
Invoke-Luma(All|Audit|Fix)\.ps1
LumaPipeline\.(psm1|Tests\.ps1)
luma-(all|audit|fix|pipeline)\.sh
run_pester\.ps1
